action_items: Consider wrapping the funnel in a React Error Boundary so a future undefined-symbol regression shows a friendly message rather than a blank screen.

Note: public /api/public/tech/sophie returns 37 enabled styles (out of 60 total). The funnel grid shows only the styles enabled by the tech — that matches Settings ('37 of 60 enabled') and is correct, but worth documenting for future testers who expect 60.
critical_code_review_comments: CustomerFunnel.jsx was missing `import StyleImage from "@/components/StyleImage"` even though StepSelect renders <StyleImage>. This caused an Uncaught ReferenceError ('StyleImage is not defined') the moment a customer reached Step 4, killing the entire funnel. Adding an ESLint rule (no-undef is enabled by default in CRA) should have caught this — recommend running `yarn lint` in CI.
No top-level Error Boundary for CustomerFunnel/Tech/Agency dashboards — any thrown error renders a blank white page in production. Add a simple ErrorBoundary that shows a recovery toast.
server.py is still ~1000+ lines; growing automations/style-intel logic compound the case for splitting into routers.

rca of the issue: BUG: Customer funnel goes blank on Step 4 (style grid). RCA: ReferenceError 'StyleImage is not defined' inside <StepSelect>. /app/frontend/src/pages/CustomerFunnel.jsx renders <StyleImage src=... category=... /> at line 393 but never imports the component. The component is defined in /app/frontend/src/components/StyleImage.jsx (and IS imported by TechDashboard.jsx, which is why Settings>Styles works). Reproduction: Open /try/sophie → click 'Try It Free' → upload a JPG → after detect step transitions, page becomes blank with a React 'error in StepSelect' warning; pageerror surfaces 'ReferenceError: StyleImage is not defined' at bundle.js:119342. Mitigation: Added `import StyleImage from "@/components/StyleImage";` after the existing imports in CustomerFunnel.jsx (line 15). Verified after fix: 7 category-tab-* testids visible, 7 style-card-* cards render, clicking a card advances to Step 5 and result-preview-image renders within 15s (AI or fallback). No console errors after fix.
